meta.title: HabitGrid | 365-Day Zero-Server Habit Tracker
meta.description: A 100% client-side web application built with Astro and React that allows users to track daily habits via a GitHub-style 365-day contribution heatmap. Zero server uploads, ensuring total privacy. Data is persisted entirely in the browser via LocalStorage.
meta.keywords: habit tracker, github contribution heatmap, 365 day habit grid, zero server habit tracker, localstorage habit tracker, daily streak graph, download habit graph png

seoSection.step1Title: 1. Click Any Day Square to Toggle Intensity
seoSection.step1Desc: Each square represents a single day across a 53-week GitHub-style contribution matrix. Click or tap a square to cycle through 4 distinct intensity states: Empty (#FFEFC4), Low (#97D7FF), Medium (#4D8DBA), and High (#086288).
seoSection.step2Desc: Powered by a custom React useLocalStorage hook, your habit matrix is immediately serialized to your browser storage. Switch effortlessly between the current year (2026) and future years (2027–2030) with zero data collision.
seoSection.step3Title: 3. Export Crisp PNG Streak Cards via HTML5 Canvas
seoSection.step3Desc: Click "Download Graph" to invoke our native high-DPI HTML5 Canvas engine. It renders your complete 365-day contribution heatmap, streak metrics, and custom color legend into a clean, shareable PNG image.
seoSection.faq1Q: Is my habit tracker data ever uploaded to a server?
seoSection.faq1A: Never. HabitGrid is a 100% zero-server client-side application. Your habit boards and daily intensity logs live exclusively inside your browser via the LocalStorage API. You can also export a JSON backup file anytime.
seoSection.faq2Q: How do the 4 heatmap intensity colors work?
seoSection.faq2A: Clicking a day square cycles through four carefully calibrated hex tones: Level 0 Empty (#FFEFC4 warm cream), Level 1 Low (#97D7FF sky blue), Level 2 Medium (#4D8DBA ocean blue), and Level 3 High (#086288 deep teal).
seoSection.faq3Q: Can I track current and future years and export my graph for social media?
seoSection.faq3A: Yes! Use the year selector to log and plan habits across 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029, and 2030. Each year is isolated in LocalStorage, and clicking "Download Graph" exports a high-resolution PNG image ready to share.
